registration_note: The previous latest-only argmax interface remains a replicated negative boundary. This new development screen changes the representation, not the seed or success threshold after scoring: it preserves the exact current-version posterior as a posterior-weighted latent codebook mean instead of prematurely collapsing it to one MAP label. Unmasked/reversed history and the old argmax read remain ablations.
old_codebook_template: An obsolete earlier memory said that the value label was{value}.
new_codebook_template: A later overwrite set the current value label to{value}.
query_template: Episode query {key}. The earlier value was overwritten. The current value label is
text_replay_template: An obsolete earlier memory said that the value label was{old}. A later overwrite set the current value label to{new}. {query}
success_rule: paired 95pct lower confidence bound greater than zero
failure_rule: paired 95pct upper confidence bound less than zero
development_decision: A positive point estimate and positive lower bound authorize an untouched replication seed. A non-positive point estimate or upper bound below zero ends this redesign without depth/round/template tuning.
interpretation: Development-only test of whether preserving posterior uncertainty through the latest-version latent replay resolves the old argmax overwrite boundary. Clean exact-KV remains an unbeatable raw-storage oracle and is not the target claim.
